In this case, invoking Lambda results in a 500 error, such as ClientExecutionTimeoutException, ServiceException, AWSLambdaException, or SdkClientException. As a best practice, proactively handle these exceptions in your state machine to Retry invoking your Lambda function, or to Catch the error.

claim: To avoid reaching the execution event history quota in long-running executions, you can use the Map state in Distributed mode, where each iteration runs as a child workflow execution with its own separate execution history.
question: How can a long-running Step Functions workflow avoid reaching the execution history quota?

values.display: Use the Map state in Distributed mode
its own, separate execution history

evidence.quote: Use the Map state in Distributed mode. In this mode, the Map state runs each iteration as a child workflow execution, which enables high concurrency of up to 10,000 parallel child workflow executions. Each child workflow execution has its own, separate execution history from that of the parent workflow.
